standard.summary: 训练开始前应用到 Anima DiT 的 adapter checkpoint（如已有 LoRA/adapter 权重）；留空则不加载。UI 上以 dit_adapter_path 填写时会自动映射到本键。
standard.effect: 模型加载后、训练开始前，通过 LoRA 注入器把该 adapter 加载到 DiT 上，训练在「底座+adapter」的组合行为上进行。与 network_weights（续训同一 LoRA）不同：这是叠加一个外部 adapter 作为环境。
standard.whenToUse: 想在某个已有 Anima adapter 的效果基础上训练新 LoRA（类似 SDXL 的预融合场景，但以可卸载 adapter 形式生效）时。
standard.avoidWhen: 与 assistant_lora_path、prefuse_adapter_path 属于互斥/易混淆的路径族（assistant_lora 有显式冲突校验）；不需要外部 adapter 环境时留空。

standard_en.summary: An adapter checkpoint -- existing LoRA or adapter weights -- applied to the Anima DiT before training starts; leave it empty to load nothing. Filling in dit_adapter_path in the UI maps to this key automatically.
standard_en.effect: After the model loads and before training starts, the LoRA injector loads that adapter onto the DiT, and training then happens on the combined behaviour of base plus adapter. Different from network_weights, which continues training the same LoRA: this stacks an external adapter as the environment.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you want to train a new LoRA on top of the effect of an existing Anima adapter -- similar to SDXL's pre-fusion scenario, but as a removable adapter.
standard_en.avoidWhen: It belongs to the same easily-confused, mutually exclusive path family as assistant_lora_path and prefuse_adapter_path (assistant_lora has an explicit conflict check). Leave it empty when you do not need an external adapter environment.

advanced.principle: 把外部 adapter 作为训练环境的一部分：新 LoRA 学到的是相对「底座+adapter」的残差，推理时需同时挂载两者才能还原训练分布。
advanced.intervention: trainer_prepare_mixin.py：Anima 加载参数中传入 dit_adapter_path；anima_loader.py 把路径记到 model 上；trainer_prepare_finalize_mixin.py：model_arch=anima 且路径非空时经 lora_injector.load_lora 应用；别名 dit_adapter_path 由 config_adapter 与 field_alias_map 归一。
advanced.expectedImpact: 训练起点分布对齐目标组合；产物对该 adapter 形成配套依赖。
advanced.tradeoffs: 路径受 training_path_contract 校验；adapter 与底模版本不匹配时注入报错。

advanced_en.principle: Treats an external adapter as part of the training environment: the new LoRA learns the residual relative to "base + adapter", and at inference both must be mounted together to reproduce the training distribution.
advanced_en.intervention: trainer_prepare_mixin.py: passes dit_adapter_path among the Anima load parameters; anima_loader.py records the path on the model; trainer_prepare_finalize_mixin.py: when model_arch=anima and the path is non-empty, applies it via lora_injector.load_lora; the alias dit_adapter_path is normalized by config_adapter and field_alias_map.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: The training starting distribution aligns with the target combination; the artifact develops a pairing dependency on that adapter.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The path is validated by training_path_contract; injecting errors out when the adapter doesn't match the base model version.
